description: Check that a draft campaign has its emails and return the link to it in the Pipefire console, where the user reads the emails and presses Launch themselves. This tool changes nothing and sends nothing.
name: get_launch_link

campaignId.description: The campaign id, for the other campaign tools.

link.description: Link to the campaign, where the user presses Launch in the Pipefire console.

status.description: draft or paused when ready to launch; active when already sending.

title: Get the link to launch a campaign
